`AGUIAdapter.dump_messages` now keeps the original order of parts within a `ModelRequest`. I changed `_dump_request_parts` in `pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/ui/ag_ui/_adapter.py`.

Consecutive user content still goes into one `UserMessage`. That group is now emitted at its original position and ends whenever a `ToolMessage` or an uploaded-file `ActivityMessage` comes next. Any user content after that starts a new `UserMessage`. A single text item is still simplified to a plain string. All `SystemPromptPart`s are still combined into one `SystemMessage` emitted first for the request.

I added two tests at the end of `tests/test_ag_ui.py`, one for each example in your description. They pass, and the existing `tests/test_ag_ui.py` tests all pass. I didn't run the type checker, lint, or the rest of the test suite, and I didn't update docs or skills.

I did not commit anything.
